title: Pro Model Reasoning and Readiness Truth: GPT-5.5-pro no longer receives unsupported low effort

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.148 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.148 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow provider-request compatibility and manifest-truth release; focused coverage plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.147 GPT-5.5-pro ZIP/log audit. A fresh deployed v0.15.148 run is required before comparing model quality without request-configuration noise.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: Fresh v0.15.147 GPT-5.5-pro Python ZIP/log evidence exported 93/A and regraded 94/A locally, with partial enrichment caused by unsupported low-effort API errors rather than a clean model-quality comparison.
OpenAI pro reasoning profiles advertise medium/high/xhigh instead of minimal/low/medium/high.
Task-level low-effort requests normalize upward to the minimum supported reasoning tier before provider request construction, while compatible GPT-5 mini requests still use low.
Package manifest readiness preserves partial-enrichment blockers after a package quality warning is merged.
Focused regressions cover both the GPT-5.5-pro reasoning clamp and the graded partial-enrichment manifest merge.

knownRemainingTargets: A fresh deployed v0.15.148 GPT-5.5-pro ZIP/log audit must prove native authoring and enrichment no longer fail because of unsupported low-effort API requests.
Only after that retest should GPT-5.5-pro quality be compared against other models for content, citation, texture, and retry behavior.
Source review rows still need URL/license proof before becoming trusted bibliography rows; this release does not broaden source trust.
Texture remains below the long-running target until fresh packages repeatedly reach 100/100 texture with no repeated-shingle caveat.
